# More efficient version with incremental vector tracking
def find_costas_fast(n):
    perm = [None] * n
    used_rows = [False] * n
    vectors = set()
    
    def backtrack(col):
        if col == n:
            return True
        
        for row in range(n):
            if used_rows[row]:
                continue
            
            # Compute new vectors with all previous marks
            new_vecs = []
            valid = True
            for prev_col in range(col):
                dc = col - prev_col
                dr = row - perm[prev_col]
                v = (dr, dc)
                if v in vectors:
                    valid = False
                    break
                new_vecs.append(v)
            
            if valid:
                perm[col] = row
                used_rows[row] = True
                for v in new_vecs:
                    vectors.add(v)
                
                if backtrack(col + 1):
                    return True
                
                # Undo
                for v in new_vecs:
                    vectors.remove(v)
                perm[col] = None
                used_rows[row] = False
        
        return False
    
    if backtrack(0):
        return perm
    return None
